name: Beverage Can (330ml)
note: Standard 330ml can is ~66mm diameter x 115mm tall. Modeled here as its square bounding box (66x66) since the engine only packs rectangles today — real circular cans nest tighter than a square-in-square grid, so real-world counts will be higher than this preset predicts. Generic, not any specific brand.

name: Wine Bottle (750ml)
note: Typical Bordeaux-style 750ml bottle, ~76mm diameter x 300mm tall. Same bounding-box caveat as the can.

name: Cereal Box (large)
note: Typical large cereal carton footprint; exact sizes vary by product/manufacturer.

name: 1L Beverage Carton (gable-top)
note: Typical 1L gable-top/brick-style carton footprint (e.g. milk/juice cartons); exact sizes vary by manufacturer. Generic, not any specific brand.

name: Medium Shipping/Moving Box
note: Common US "medium" moving-box size (18x18x16in), empty weight only — add product weight separately.

name: Aerosol Can (65mm)
note: 65mm is one of the standard aerosol can diameters (45/52/65mm are the common sizes); height varies by fill volume. Bounding-box caveat applies, same as the beverage can.

name: Paint Can (1 US Gallon)
note: Standard US 1-gallon paint can, ~6.5in diameter x 7.75in tall (empty weight only — full paint adds ~4-5kg). Bounding-box caveat applies, same as the beverage can.

name: PET Bottle (2L)
note: Typical 2L PET soft-drink bottle, ~105mm diameter x 320mm tall, filled weight. Bounding-box caveat applies, same as the beverage can. Generic, not any specific brand.

name: Beverage Can (355ml / 12oz US)
note: Standard US 12oz (355ml) can, ~66mm diameter x 122mm tall — same diameter as the 330ml can but taller. Bounding-box caveat applies, same as the beverage can.

name: RSC Shipping Case (medium)
note: Generic mid-size Regular Slotted Container shipper (FEFCO 0201), filled weight — a common secondary-pack footprint used as a primary pack when it's itself loaded onto a pallet without a further case.

name: Tin Can (400g / soup-size)
note: Typical 400g food tin ("soup can" size), ~73mm diameter x 110mm tall, filled weight. Bounding-box caveat applies, same as the beverage can. Generic, not any specific brand.
